questions_and_answers.assessment_review: Original speaking phrase practice and one five-task, 10-mark role-play. Short 1–4 mark groups are practice allocations. The two scene prompts are written contexts, not substitutes for the official two-photo card. Current assessment is role-play 10; reading aloud 5 plus holistic four-question conversation 10; photo description 5 plus unprepared conversation communication 15/language 5. No old-course prepared general-conversation model is used.
